ai_summary.text:
ユーザーローカルはSNS分析・AI解析ツールのSaaS企業。SNSマーケティング分析ツールとAIテキストマイニング・チャットボットを主力に、企業のデジタルマーケティングとAI活用を支援している。

売上46億円（前年比+17.3%）と高い成長率。営業利益20億円（営業利益率43%）、純利益14億円。SaaS型の高い収益構造が43%という驚異的な営業利益率を実現。ROE16.4%と高い資本効率。

自己資本比率87.2%、財務健全性スコア100点と最高評価の財務。営業CF18億円、FCF15億円とほぼ全額がFCFとして残る。EPS89円に対しPER21.3倍、配当14円。生成AIの普及で企業のAI活用ニーズは急拡大しており、テキストマイニングとSNS分析のデータ基盤が新たなAIサービスの展開を支えている。なお、EPS88.9円、PER21.3倍、1株当たり配当金14.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: User Local is a SaaS company for SNS analysis and AI analysis tools. With SNS marketing analysis tools and AI text mining/chatbots as its main products, it supports companies' digital marketing and AI utilization.  Sales are growing at a high rate of  4.6 billion (up 17.3% year-on-year). Operating profit was  2.0 billion (operating profit margin of 43%) and net profit was  1.4 billion. The SaaS-type high-profit structure realizes an extraordinary operating profit margin of 43%. A high ROE of 16.4% indicates high capital efficiency.  The equity ratio is 87.2% and the financial soundness score is 100 points, the highest rating for finances. Operating CF is  1.8 billion and FCF is  1.5 billion, with almost the entire amount remaining as FCF. With an EPS of  89 and a PER of 21.3x, the dividend is  14. With the spread of generative AI, companies' needs for AI utilization are rapidly expanding, and the data base of text mining and SNS analysis is supporting the development of new AI services. In addition, the company is promoting management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value improvement, with an EPS of  88.9, PER of 21.3x, and a dividend per share of  14.0.
